item.title: Lakes State SPLM-IO faces mass defection, key members return to SPLM Party
item.description: A seismic shift in Lakes State politics as key figures including MPs, ministers, and commission heads defect back to the SPLM party, shaking up the political landscape

item.title: Days after explosion, army orders civilians living in Giada to evacuate
item.description: Residents of Giada express concerns and worries over the military police's directive to evacuate within seven days, highlighting challenges faced by families of soldiers in finding alternative accommodation amidst lack of support from the government

item.title: Soldier arrested for shooting neighbour in the head
item.description: A soldier has been arrested for shooting his neighbor at Mapau area along Juba - Bor Highway over a child abuse incident involving a heated altercation that tragically resulted in Deng Ayiei being shot in the head.

item.title: Supreme Court drops charges against priest who was jailed for plotting to kill Rumbek Bishop
item.description: The Reverend Father was convicted in 2022 at Juba High Court over conspiracy alongside three others after the shooting of the then bishop-elect, Christian Carlassare of Rumbek Catholic Diocese.

item.title: T Manager says online beef with other artists is for fun, not serious
item.description: In his speech at the NCA’s event dubbed 4th Town Hall, he urged the public not to misinterpret the beef and reminded them that it's a way for public figures to showcase talent and motivate themselves.

item.title: John Frog releases a new song titled "Hajat Kaab"
item.description: In the audio, John Frog talked about the higher exchange of the US dollar against the South Sudanese Pound and the rise in market prices. He also called upon God to help South Sudan in this critical situation.

item.title: Twic East Community reduces bride price to encourage youthful marriages
item.description: This significant reduction from previous customary practices aims to alleviate financial burdens on families and facilitate easier marriages among the younger generation

item.title: Fifteen children die of heat-related diseases
item.description: On Friday, Minister of Information and Government Spokesperson, Michael Makuei, disclosed to journalists in Juba that fifteen children have tragically lost their lives due to heat-related causes.

item.title: John Akec to remain at University of Juba, assumes new role
item.description: In a social media post, Prof. Akec revealed that the new university vice chancellor has appointed him to a new role as the Project Director of the Mayardit Academy for Space Science.

item.title: Golden Brains Academy wins Juba Secondary Schools Mini Competition
item.description: Golden Brains Academy triumphed in the inaugural Juba Secondary Schools Mini Spelling Bee, Speed Challenge Quiz, Speech, and Academic Debate Competition, besting Elite High School in the Grand Finale.
